svg.title: Radar cube memory and the four receive channels
svg.desc: Four stacked channel planes. The range FFT acts down samples within a chirp; the Doppler FFT acts across successive chirps. A highlighted column marks one chirp. A board inset identifies the four AWR2944 receive antennas.
svg.text: From receiver channels to a radar cube
Range and Doppler processing act along different dimensions
Antenna channels form the cube’s depth.
Each plane holds the sample/chirp data for one receive channel.
Adapted from TI’s FMCW processing diagram, slide 12. Board image: Texas Instruments, AWR2944EVM.
